qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md: 'A negative needs a successful control'
evidence: Nearly every negative leg is paired in-criterion with a success case: render gate (wrong password / nothing pre-sign-in vs Gwen signs in, gates/render/judge.toml:26-30); constraints gate (reload + cross-context readback); signin_and_client_scope (recorded list/thread/mentions/search/transcript requests explicitly labelled positive controls before signed-out replays; M-11 post before M-12 cross-post); wall_every_route (Sian's thread/search/transcript controls, Dev's 'Survey booked' search, JUDGE-W1 reply before the JUDGE-W2 replay); wall_mentions_and_links (Harriet preview/link, JUDGE-M2 mention, M-11 suggestions); wall_added_live (Sian's own post request and M-11 access, lift restores); deleted_and_expired (search 'Clause 14 noted', one-second-younger message, Gwen's delete before Sian's replay); timer_changes (earlier version listed and request recorded before replay, executor still found, Sian can see M-13, Harriet's timer change works); hold_scope_and_release (leg 1 delete, leg 6 search control, Harriet's hold/release before Sian's replays); edits_and_stale_edit (first edit saves before stale/hijack; mention appears before removal checks); safe_formatting (bold/code/link/quote render, literal text visible); message_links; unread (count 2 before cleared states); sent_once (D2 control); live_updates (LA/LR/LE appear); search Part C (Q1/Q3/Q5 found, '1000 pounds' control); persistence (step c controls). Polish delete_confirm and refusal_in_place pair decline/refusal with confirm/correct password; functional prompt.md:32 and polish prompt.md:26 make unperformed steps fail. The one gap is polish escape_closes (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml, criterion escape_closes): it credits 'Escape saves or posts nothing' and 'no edited mark' after reload, but nowhere in that criterion is a normal edit save or reply send shown to work, so the not-saving half can be earned by a dead save/reply path.
counterexample: An app whose Escape handler calls the same submit-and-close routine as Enter (violating conversations.md:29 'Escape closes an open edit or reply without saving anything'), but whose edit PATCH and reply POST are broken (e.g. wrong route, 404 swallowed). Escape closes both boxes, the reload shows 'Escape check JUDGE-K3' unedited and no 'Escaped reply JUDGE-K3', so escape_closes scores 1 (1/6 of polish, ~0.033 reward) even though Escape actually saves and editing/replying are dead. Impact bounded because such an app loses heavily in functional edits/replies criteria; no run measured it.
suggested_fix: In escape_closes, add an in-criterion positive control after the Escape checks, e.g. 'Then open the edit control again, change the text to "Saved edit JUDGE-K3" and save: after a reload it reads that with an edited mark; open the reply control, type "Sent reply JUDGE-K3" and send: it appears (positive controls)', and fail if either control does not work.
